  2. Powersaving mode is awesome.
  
  Powersaving mode is excellent. Once while I traveling the remaining battery was showing 15% and I changed the phone to power saving mode which will switch off all other features of the phone except SMS and Call. Next day morning it just used 3% and still 12% was remaining and I did not miss any calls till I reached to the destination.
  

  3. Camera is wonderful. As they advertise, the quality of picture matches with a professional camera.
  

  4. Secure Zone and Open Zone - Wonderful feature of this phone. I was not aware of this feature initially and configured my Mails, Whatsapp, facebook etc in Open zone. Later I had to set the phone to factory mode and reconfigured everything in Secured Zone. All your friends will enjoy all the common apps which is freely available in the Open Zone. All your personal details will be safe in secure zone until you share your password.
  

  5. 3G speed is very good - With idea network I tested the 3 G speed upto 9.8 Mbps in speedtest.net
  



  Cons: 1. User interface is average below.
  
  There are multiple issues with the user interface of this mobile. It seems the mobile was released before completing all the UAT (User Acceptance Test) of the UI (User Interface).
  

  Issue 1 : Even after finishing a call, the last call status will be showed in full screen. We will get scared thinking the call is not disconnected after long time.
  

  Issue 2 : If you already established a call with open mode and you are searching a whatsapp image in secured mode, meanwhile if you are getting another call, whatsapp image will get stuck and you can not go to call mode to see who is calling or hold the current call and switch to the new call. You will be able to do anything in the phone only after the second call ringing gets over or disconnected.
  

  Issue 3: There is an option for closing all your open windows in the phone. You will have to pull the left side screen and you can see a button to remove all the open windows at once. This button may work only if you are lucky. Otherwise you will have to close each and every window manually by pushing the window upwards. Sometimes this button will work and it will close all the windows but the first one. You need to manually close that window
  

  Issue 4: Sometimes the phone will start vibrate like anything and you can see lots of windows are opening and closing. Its scary. This bug needs to be fixed immediately.
  

  Issue 5: Sometimes you will not get calls even if you have full reception. I don't know whether it is a service provider issue or mobile phone issue
  

  Issue 6: You can see you are getting a call and before you attend the call it gets disconnected unfortunately. While you go to the missed call history there will not be any signs of this call. weird..!!
  

  There are still more issues related with the User Interface which I don't recollect now. Anyway, shifting from Apple Iphone to Lenovo is disastrous in terms of user interface
  

  2. While using camera, phone gets heated.
  
  While you use your mobile camera for sometime. you will pray not to get any calls. To attend that call either you will have to put the call in speaker mode or use a bluetooth.
  
  But once you switch off the camera, heat will come down quickly bcoz of the aluminum body
  

  If these two issues are not there, this would be a unbeatable phone in the market.

column3: Lenovo Vibe Z2 Pro (Starry Night Black, 32 GB)
column7:
Choosing a phone is not a simple job any more. We all look for maximum features at minimum price. I believe that a phone's life is two years; so, the phone that I use should not get obsolete during these two years. I was using Iphone 4s and I must confess, I was cursing my phone for horrible battery back up (only 6-7 hours on a 3g network).
  

  I travel a lot and have to respond to many emails and messages on the go. Moreover, I follow news very regularly so I decided to go for a big screen phones like Iphone 6 plus or Nexus 6. But the price points of these phones were prohibitive.
  

  After a lot of research on youtube and various other websites, I zeroed down to Lenovo Z2 Pro. One great feature of this phone was mammoth 4000mah battery. I hate to carry battery banks along. All other features of this phone were comparable to nexus 6.
  

  Recently, I saw a discount on the Flipkart and I got this phone for Rs. 27,999. Man this phone blows the competition away by an unmatched ROI (return on investment). A similar specification phone like nexus 6 is costs a good 20 grand more. That's a lot of money.
  

  This phone works like a charm. There is no lag and even a full day usage with 3g network, heavy calling and surfing leaves me with good 30-40 percent of battery at the end of the day. This is very significant as this is a dual sim phone. I would like to add that this phone is LTE ready. So as and when 4G is launched in delhi, I can easily upgrade. column6: A Solid phone, but if you want LTE feature. Stay away.
column7:
I purchased this phone getting tired of waiting for an invite for the One Plus One.
  
  First lets cover the pros.
  

  1. Beautiful 6" Screen,2K Screen produces vivid colors and awesome video watching experience.
  

  2. Big phone, amazing reading experience as well as video watching experience. Those who want 1 device to satisfy their eBook reading needs, mobile gaming and the occasional video watching. This phone does all this with panache.
  

  3.Loud speakers, putting gaana.com or youtube music on speakers produces decent sound. Ofcourse there are reviews who say the sound quality isn't that good, but I say its clear, its loud and if you want top notch sound then go buy a bluetooth speaker from sony or bose and pair with the phone
  

  4. Call quality is pretty decent, when put on speaker its loud and audible. No problems with signal inside buildings.
  

  5. 4000mAh battery with 3g use, ocassional gaming struggles to go through a day. But thats expected. It goes for more than 16hrs, which is decent. I have supplemented this with a 10000mAh Mi power bank and all is cool with the world.
  

  6. Terrific cam, the 16mp camera takes beautiful pictures. I am yet to utilize all the plethora of settings they have given, but the shots I have taken are far better than the 2 year old Note 2 produces.
  

  7. Zippy performance. The quadcore snapdragon 801 with 2.5gHz clocked core with 3gb ram shows. The day I got the phone I had installed 100+ apps straight away. With these same app, my 2 year old Note 2 was crying,whimpering and struggling all the way. R.I.P Note 2. This beast handles all that I threw at it with ease and its really zips through them all.
  

  8. Metal case, solid premium feel. The Lenovo boot screen, is sexy as hell.
  

  9. Allows switching to vanilla google's default android UI .
  

  Cons:
  
  -------
  
  1. No LTE love here :'( . LTE doesn't work in India. Its because Airtel and other 4g providers are operating in India @ 2300mHz band while this device doesn't support.This is a big bummer for me. I almost threw the phone down. I haven't still decided what to do. I am pretty dissapointed. I would have given this phone 5 stars, but this really hurt.
  

  2. Gets warm on extended gaming or video watching. The Metal casing acts as heat sink , which is good for the battery and internals, but your hand and skin ends up facing the heat...so to speak. But once I put in the Lenovo cover, it insulates me from the heat and thats a relief.
  

  3. Big, while Note2 fits snugly in my jeans pocket, this one pokes out. If you are ok with it , alls cool. I am ok with it. 6" phone. duh.
  

  There, my view of the phone.
  
  I love this phone , it has such a beautiful screen, I can read novels, ebooks on it all day long. Typing whatsapp telegram and chat messengers is easier because of the bigger screen ( i have got big hands ) ...its fast enough to play all the games I throw at it and takes cool snaps... I just love it.
  
  and I now hate it because airtel tells me nothing is wrong with the device but LTE wont work. wtf man. Lenovo before launching in india should you not declare this ?

column6: Beast of a phone. Best buy at the moment
column7:
Specs that stand out: 16mp back cam , 2k screen, 3gb ram, 4000mah battery, dimensions of the phone similar to 5.5" but it's exactly 6"
  

  Coming onto the bad reviews we saw earlier is mainly attributed to how hot the phone gets when you use camera. Honestly it does get too hot unbearable to hold in just under 5 mins. But once you update the device with the frequent updates all of this is minimized to something bearable. I use a cubic back cover for this and that will prevent heat from reaching your hands.
  

  FYI: lollipop update is out and heard that the phone is much snappier but some features like power manager is now gone so haven't updated.
  

  Bought the phone 2months ago and it works like a charm. I'm an avid multimedia user so movies on this device with 2k screen is brilliant. Especially for those who use google cardboard for the VR experience. Pixel density of 495 ppi is bearable to minimise the screen door effect. Watching every movie on it and it is amazing.
  

  Haven't tried much of gaming, tried UFC and works well as expected as you know it's a adreno 330.
  

  Sound quality of the stock earphones are amazing(only on the fusion music player with  fx booster on) tried with google play music and it's just as with any other high end phone. Flat cables are good.
  

  Battery life should be stellar as everyone may think but will last you 2 days only if u are a minimal user. Heavy usage should last a day. Surprisingly this does not have the quick charge ability of Qualcomm but still charges within an hour :)
  

  Camera pictures cannot be scaled down to any other resolution except 16 mp. So images will be very high res and as a result you cannot update them on Instagram as stock. You need an image editor to bring them down. I don't know why this is the case, maybe I am wrong is there some way too scale down images?
  

  Picture quality is great but you require stable hands. Yes it has OIS but that's active only on low light conditions. Dual flash is too good. Video capture is great on 4k and other resolutions. Slow mo is a total disaster. Night videos slow down a bit may be to 22 fps but look okay. Selfies are good with beautification on with 5mp.
  

  Overall, good phone if u are looking for a 2k screen, good music quality with fusion music player, enjoy movies at their best with Google cardboard, nice camera to replace your small digi.
  

  Sorry for the long rant. With the oneplus 2 on the horizon you can absolutely go for it but as time passes by good specs are available at a lower price. The best phone to date with 2k in the price segment of 28 to 35 is the Lenovo vibe z2 pro.

Bought this phone on 28th Jan 2017.
  
  Coming from an LG g2(the best phone i used till date!), This had huge gaps to fill.
  

  Why i brought it-
  
  1. Performance- SD 820!
  
  2. Price- 15k!
  
  3. Build- the roll cage design( lost my g2 due to phusical damage).
  

  The facts-
  
  1. Performance- awesome!! On par with One+3
  
  3. Build-It has got the most functional build I have seen. It feels like its indestructible and drops dont have too much impact barring scratches. But!! Its got near flat edges, so it isnt very comfortable in the hand.
  
  4. Camera- both front and camera are good in daylight. Will comfortably do your social media duties with ease. Not a deal breaker.
  
  5. Heating issue- honestly, the phone heats up, a lot when u use it constantly but again all phones do and with so much performance, its understandable. ( Warning- if the phone heats up too much, take it to the service centre, issue should be fixed. Which happened to me)
  
  6. Ergonomics- for people comfortable with small phones, the choices are limited! However, the glass back makes it the slippest things you'll ever use. Probably can be used to test the flatness of a surface :)
  
  7. Battery backup- a day with 4G data used throughout, not many phones can do that! U dont miss quick charge a lot but it would help.
  
  8. Updates- remember this is not a moto( even they are getting bad) so don't expect the latest software.
  
  9. Custom ROMs- if u hate the UI and want to try other ROMs( which is probably the only reason u would), u will be disappointed. The dev community isnt that great with very few good ROMs.
  
  10. Customisations- again there aren't a lot of aftermarket skins and back cover available ( should say something;)
  

  2. Cost- this is just a personal opinion based on above facts.
  

  My conclusion-
  
  1. The phone isn't useable without a back cover because of the heat and the glass back.
  
  2. Do not buy this phone if u think ur getting a flagship phone. It does have the specs but its implementations are to be improved or if u can live with a bigger phones( the flat edges kill it here).
  
  3. Buy this phone for the price.
  

  Looking forward for the Zuk Z3!!

Dear Guys, I'm writing this review after 1 week of regular usage of lenovo Z2 plus. I bought this phone on 6th Feb from flipkart after exchanging my Asus Zen 5. Though intially I was a bit skeptical whether to opt for a lenovo phone bt I don't regret my decision.
  
  Let us get into the pros and cons of this phone after 1 week of use.
  
  Pros:
  
  1. Since the phone runs on the flagship Qualcomm Snapdragon 820 processor with adreno 530 GPU, lag is the last tging that would come into your mind. Multitasking felt smooth like never before.
  
  2. Next great advantage is the battery life. With moderate usage the 3500mAh battery lasted about 2days. The processor minimises the heats loss to least.
  
  3. The z2 plus is provided with a google launcher and the ZUI gives you a nearly stock android feel. UI is very simple and looks elegant.
  
  4. The 5" Full HD display with 441 ppi give  a bright screen with perfect color contrast.
  
  5. The bulit quality is pretty unique and instead of a metal lenovo has opted for a magnesium alloy bosy sandwich ed between 2.5 D curves glass front and back
  
  5. The sound output from my previous phone made me regret but this one didn't. The mono speaker at the bottom produces a sound loud enough to be audible even in the crowdeat place. The microphone hole is set just on the left of it. The volume keys are set on the top of power button.
  
  6. Lastly the single button at the buttom is an unique feature of this phone. It is at the same time a home screen button, fingerprint sensor and app window. If you get used to it, you will love it.
  

  Cons:
  
  1. Inspite of having a premium phone's features, the rear 13mp camera is decent but not that laudible compared to its competitors like one plus 3 and mi 5. It also lags in optical image stabilizer. Low light pics arenot that great either. However the front camera with 8mp takes really great pics.
  
  2. There is absence of any Gorilla Glass on screen.However it comes out of box with a matte finish screen guard that is looking decent on the screen.
  
  3. Though it supports qualcomm quick charging 3.0 but the charger inside the box isn't that one. ( Though this one is a very fast charger)
  

  So it boils down to what you need. If you need a premium looking phone with a blazing fast processor, decent camera and a quality built product, then blindly opt for this.

Processor/ GPU - The best of its class. High end graphic games works smoothly. No lag anywhere and absolutely no quality issues. Heating is there but not too much.
  

  Display - Awesome !! The phone comes with a 'matte finish' plastic screen guard which takes away the beauty of the display. The display looks so dull with that screen guard. So replace it with a tampered glass one or use it with no screen guard.
  

  Camera - Too good with digital camera quality. I think the negative reviews about it is mainly because the images look very raw and natural whereas some other phones do a lot of artificial software gimmicks to enhance the images. There are no such 'artificial' things in this and I personally like it. Artificial enhancements can be done with other applications.
  

  Battery - the battery consumption is average. For medium usage, the battery will last for maximum 2 days. The display consumes most of the power. So adjust the brightness to extend the battery life.
  

  Typos and grammar mistakes - Yes, there are many typos and grammar mistakes spread across the UI which largely gives a feeling that a lot of improvement required in quality/ proofing.
  

  Sensors/ touch - Just like any other phone, all works great. Nothing special and no issues so far.
  

  Charging - this phones DOES NOT support quick charge 3.0 eventhough the processor it has supports it. Its nowhere written in the user manual that it supports QC 3.0. If you try quick charge, it will damage the charging circuit. Use a normal charger (1A or 2A).

  4.Connectivity(3.5/5): It is dual SIM.First slot supports upto 4G and Second slot upto 2G.
  
  Both are micro sim.I live in Indore, where there is no 4G but 3G and 2G worked very well.

  5.Storage(2/5):Lenovo is giving an internal storage of 16GB and good thing is whole space is available for apps and all stuff.

Lenovo has promised to release lollipop Update for it. Lenovo has released some updates, but i suggest to take some time before downloading any updates, because some updates may disappoint you.
  

  7.Battery(3/5):It has 2300 mAh replacable battery, which once charged upto 100%, gives me a backup for whole day, with average use like surfing, playing games, watching videos.I turn on data, only when i need it, so it may vary from person to person.In idle condition, battery drop is 1-2% in 2hrs, which is good.

  With so many good features and hardware it has only one major Con that troubled me a lot and that is HEATING.When i searched, i found that almost every person having it, suffering from same problem.
  
  I also complained flipkart about this issue and asked for replacement, but their answer was "It is normal for this phone to heat upto 48degrees and unless it is upto that temperature, we will not replace it."In user manual, came with phone, it is mentioned that don't operate it above 42degree, So their excuse is totally unacceptable.
  
  So I searched more and found that when I unmount my 16GB class 10 memory card, the heating issue is gone and this is the reason, i gave 2 out of 5 for Storage, When u can't use expandable memory what is the use of it.Looks like, I am using a Pen drive.The reason for this is, their ROM is not able to manage 'Mediaserver' app effectively,
  
  when i checked, i found it was consuming 80% of battery, which is not more than 5& in other phones.One solution i found for this issue, is putting a .nomedia file on your memory card and then use it.In this case some apps will not show content of memory
  
  card, but this is how u have to use it.
  

  So overall a good phone for 7.5k, with only one major drawback, HEATING.May be in future updates, they will resolve this issue and the phone will be perfect.

column6: Lenovo A6000 Plus - heating and batter issue resolved
column7:
Hello All,
  

  I have bought Lenovo A6000 plus from Flipkart some 15 days back. Returned the product within 5 days due to batter issue and very high level of heating of the phone.
  

  I got replacement of the phone - still same issue. So the culprit was not the battery and I started looking  for solution.
  

  The issue was with the SD Card (I used 32GB SD Card as is form my older android phone running on v4.2) To try
  
  1. I backed the data on SD card, erased the data completely while the card was in new phone (Lenovo A6000 plus).
  
  2. un-mount the SD card.
  
  3. Shutdown the phone.
  
  4. Remove the SD Card from it's slot.
  
  5. Start phone without SD Card.
  
  6. Keep phone running for around 2-3 minutes.
  
  7. Shutdown the phone.
  
  8. Insert the SD card which was erased and un-mounted into SD card slot and start the phone.
  
  9. Start using the phone for around 10-15 mins.
  
  10. Now do one last shutdown and start of the phone.
  

  This procedure has helped me resolve the high batter consumption issue as well as excessive heating issue of the phone.
  

  Hope this will help others to get similar issues resolved.
  
  After this the phone runs very smoothly and of course as suggested by others here try to disable/uninstall unnecessary softwares that comes pre-loaded. this will help in making phone even better in terms of responsiveness and increased internal storage will be added benefit.
  

  Thanks,
  
  Swapnil

I got the phone a couple of days back and let me highlight my usage facts.
  

  Performance - Noticed stuttering/lagging every couple of seconds even on less intensive games such as Angry Birds, Subway Surfers and Temple Run. However the lag is less pronounced on heavy games such as Dead Trigger 2 and Riptide GP2 and hardly noticeable. The lag is quite annoying such that playing the above basic games is an eyesore.
  

  Display - The display is an IPS HD display (1280 x 720 - very common in these range phones) which is sharp and the brightness good enough (not too high).
  
  Sound - The twin speakers are quite loud enough and the sound is crisp. The Dolby effect is good for the price. No complaints here.
  
  Browsing - Browsing experience was smooth with the inbuilt chrome browser.
  
  GPS - Got an accurate lock on my location even when inside my home away from the windows. No complaints here as well.
  
  Camera - Average 8 MP camera which is good enough for the casual shooters but not pros. Details are not well highlighted and pictures seem to be quite saturated. Front camera is good but not great.
  
  Storage - This is one place where Lenovo beats similar priced phones. You get about 11.5 GB out of 16 gigs.
  
  RAM - This is another area where Lenovo outsmarts similar price tags. As stated, the RAM is 2 GB and you get about 1.3 - 1.4GB free RAM.
  
  Heating - I didn't notice much heating as many have posted. Probably, the firmware I am using (Kraft-A6000-s_S010_150515) is throttling the CPU or battery heat as was the case in prev Redmi 1s firmware. Maybe the lags in UI and games could be because of this.
  
  Battery - I noticed that the battery life is not bad. It lasted an average of a day's charge on normal usage with some casual gaming. May be this has to also do with some CPU throttling as stated above.
  
  Overall, based on my usage, if you are casual user with frequent videos/music playback and calling/ internet browsing this is a great phone for the price.
  

  If you are more into gaming, please avoid this phone.

column6: Excellent Budget Phone Within this Price Range, Highly Recommended.
column7:
First of all to all those spammers & fake reviewers writing about Heating issues, There is little heating which is definitely under control & it can never be considered as a drawback.
  
  I am writing this review after 1 Week of High Usage.Ordered this Product on 10th June & Received on 12th Early morning, so Flipkart delivery good as always ! Before talking about anything else, Let me tell you what kind of user I am becoz in the end you will prefer the phone which match your requirements not what any xyz reviewer says. Thats the approach to be followed always.
  
  So I am not a heavy gamer 1st of all. I do play games but not always. I listen to music, watch videos & the Most part of my mobile usage is Calling, SMS, Net Surfing, Chatting etc.
  
  Now come to the review things, I will rate most of the important aspects within 5.
  
  1) CAMERA (Primary 8 MP , Secondary 2 MP) :- In Camera section I would say it gives you a decent experience, pictures come out to be nice. However i would consider the Primary Camera as not good as expected. Though the size of images which it captures is above 2 MB, but whenever We try to zoom it on a Computer Screen the pixels get blurred after applying 3XZoom. However the color reproduction is nice & pictures are detailed. All this is about Daytime Images, while in Night it does decent job but in indoor condition with low lighting if we flash for clicking a pic at larger distance the Pics are VERY POOR
  
  Talking about Selfi Cam, some times it Feels It gives better experience than the primary one. The Secondary camera is a 2 MP shooter which does a nice job.
  
  Overall for Camera Section I will give : 3/5 for Primary & 4/5 for Secondary Cam.
  
  2) BATTERY : For many people, battery is very major aspect of mobile usage. The battery in device does an awesome Job. Talking about my experience when I am fully connected to internet using net based apps, a full 100% charge battery gave me a backup of 16+ Hrs. I WAS CONNECTED TO WIFI FOR THE WHOLE 16 HRS CONTINUOUSLY. Also I played games, listened to music, done calling.
  
  If we do normal calling say (10-12 Calls a day) + Music/ Videos (1 Hr) + Net Surfing/Chatting (2-3 Hrs) + Gaming (15 Min to 30 Min), then the battery is expected to give 15-17 Hrs of Backup.
  
  The Standby Time is surely above 20+ hrs, which include only Calling of few calls a day. Would give 4.5/5 for the Battery
  
  3) Sound Quality, Voice Call Quality, Ringtone Volumes : The Call quality for Voice calls are good. Also the speakers gave a very nice experience while playing games or listing music on speakers & making loud speaker calls. Also the Ringtone Volume is decent, not much Loud but its OK.
  
  4/5 for this Section.
  
  4) Gaming : Though I am not gamer but still for testing I tried Asphalt 8, Mordern Combat 5, Real Cricket, Death Shooter 2, Hill Climbing, Temple Run, Subway Surf. I have to say all the games were running very smoothly on this device. Somewhere the 2GB RAM has huge impact in good gaming exp on this Phone. However Playing games produced a little heat up near the camera (little not too heavy) & also battery drainage is high when we play heavy games.
  
  Will give 3.5/5 for this Section.
  
  5) Processing, Touch & Internet Apps Usage : It comes with Chrome & UCB pre-installed. The internet surfing on this device is excellent. Pinch to Zoom feature works absolutely fine and websites load quite fast. Also the chatting using skype, messanger,whatsapp run very smooth. The touch is indeed very responsive & all apps run smooth. Even tried whatsapp,skype & messanger Voice Calls, all ran perfect on this Device.
  
  Will give 4/5 in this section.
  
  6) Looks,Design,Build Quality : This looks a pretty premium phone with very minimum rounded edges. The build quality is great and it supports 5 point multi touch. The only drawback in this section is the absence of Backlid menu buttons & LED Notification light.
  
  Will give 3.5/5 in this Section.
  
  7) Headphones,OTG,Charger : The phone doesnt comes with a headfone, but on listing sounds in headphones the phone does a quite remarkable Job. Also the Phone at present doesnt support OTG but I dont think I am going to use any OTG Pendrive in near future so it doesnt bother me. I got a white color USB Charger which seems to be OK type.
  

  Will give 3.5/5 in this section.
  
  Thats all from my side. I have been using this phone & I am very much satisfied with its performance apart from primary camera (not bad but not very good too). My Overall rating would be 4/5 for this Phone.
  
  PS : The phone got very very heated on 1st Boot but since 2nd Boot there never came any such issue :)
  
  Remember while buying phone take helps of reviews for getting to know about features & cons. However buy phone as per your requirement only as If I like Chocolate Icecream doesnt mean you will do the same.

I have been using this for 3 days now. Was very skeptical about it because of mixed reviews, but till now I see no major issues.
  
  Lot of reviews mention heating issues, I didn't experience that. I played Asphalt 8 for an hour, which is just enough to heat up a phone with any processor related heating issues. And by the way the gameplay was pretty smooth at default(medium) graphics setting :)
  
  Having said that it did heat up while charging, but that is not really an issue.
  

  Pros:
  

  1. Very sleek design, super light weight. I don't even realize there's a phone in my pocket.
  

  2. Excellent configuration at this price. 2 GB RAM, Snapdragon quadcore 1.2 GHz, 16 GB ROM and one feature which was pretty important to me, expandable memory slot.
  

  3. Great display quality, it's a delight to watch HD videos on this one.
  

  4. 2300 mAh battery does quite well, I suggest you get a 2A charger as it does take 2.5-3 hrs to charge from 0-100 . It lasts a whole day with moderate-heavy usage.
  

  5. Though i didn't shoot a lot, the main camera seems pretty good. Just that indoor/low light shots have visible pixels in them.
  


  Cons:
  

  1. It runs kit-kat with Vibe UI on top. I really do not like the Vibe UI. It is not so smooth, lacks aesthetic appeal. I'm waiting for either a lollipop update or a stable Cynogen ROM.
  

  2. Front camera is not good, but hey, I'm no selfie freak, so works out for me ;)
  

  3. It does get heated up while charging.
  

  4. No cornering gorilla glass(buy a good tempered glass screenguard).
  

  Overall, I'd say It is definitely a steal at this price given that there's no deal breaker cons.
  
  Go for it!

Got delivery of the A6000+ on 21st May 2015 and as per 1 Day promise from Flipkart.
  

  Readers this is one hell of a phone, and for 7499/- this is a steal -- there is no other phone in the Indian market to beat this price and specs.
  

  Lets speak about some basic features that everyone around would usually use :
  

  1. Processor -- 64Bit Snapdragon 410 @ 1.2 GHz, don't look at the Ghz, there are faster speeds in the market but this is a Snapdragon 64 bit so the processing power is just enough to take you around in pride. I am able to play heavy high-end games flawlessly on this phone including Asaphalt 8 Airbourne, Real Racing 3, NOVA, NFS, etc and that too at FULL settings. The games don't lag even a bit
  

  Complimented with 2GB RAM Apps load super fast including the games, and with multiple apps running in the background the phone still has sufficient RAM to load more.
  



  2. Camera : 8MP BSI with a very powerful Flash, both from front and back cameras so a good job especially in low lit areas. Night photography or darkly lit places are usually a nightmare for most cameras however not with Lenovo A6000+.
  

  For today's life where one visits a pub or lounge and the place is not lit so well and we want to click some photos of friends  !! Then the flash is powerful enough to light up the entire place and click superb photos.
  

  The flash also doubles into a very powerful Flash Light.
  

  3. HD screen @ 720p but flawlessly plays 1080p videos also, there is no Gorilla Glass or Dragontail or any other protection on it however one can easily but a tempered glass screen in after-market stores also on Flipkart (just in case you are careless with your phones)
  

  4. Battery -- This is the biggest enemy of all Android phone users, most low cost phones have 2000 mAh batteries that don't last more than 5-6 hours and one needs to be at charging point for most of the time.
  

  However, Lenovo has paid special attention to this factor and packed in a powerful 2300 mAh Polymer (removeable battery) battery which easily lasts 21-24 hours with moderate to heavy usage.
  

  My usage is 30-40 mins Games, 1 hour approx of calling, 3G always ON, Whatsapp is always ON and chatting on it through out the day, 2 hours of Music over Bluetooth, 4-5 hours browsing entire day.
  

  5. Speaker and Sound: Dolby Sound system and Dual Speaker give RICH and Crisp sound output especially while playing games or watching some video
  


  Please don't read reviews of users that say that this phone sucks or is horrible and all that.
  

  I am an end user and I have not come across any issues at all with this phone.
  

  Yet somethings I must state that maybe cons for most:
  

  1. Only 1 Sim Slot has 3G/4G support so if you are a dual simmer like me and need to switch 3G / 4G connectivity between two service providers then one has to open the back panel of the phone and switch SIMs manually
  

  2. The screen could have been shipped with a hardened material like Gorilla Glass or Asahi Dragontail -- however like I mentioned above there are after market solutions also available.
  

  3. The speaker output is not Loud yet the sound is crisp, that is because Dolby does not work in LOUD sounds, so if you want the speaker to sound louder then switch off Dolby
  

  And again at Rs.7499/- you go wrong with this phone

  4050 mAh battery.
  
  Has a notification LED.
  
  Music through headphone is very good with dolby atmos.
  
  Loudspeaker sound us loud enough and crispy.
  
  No lag.
  
  Smooth touch.
  
  Gorilla glass protection.
  
  Auto focus is really fast with laser auto focus and PDAF.
  
  Has a front flash.
  
  Front cam is very good.
  
  Minor heating while charging but acceptable, so no heating issue.
  
  Good full hd display which is sharp and vivid, mesmerizing display.
  
  Fingerprint scanner is very fast and accurate.
  
  call quality is good crystal clear voice.
  
  You will get around 23.75 GB user space.
  
  When no app is running you'll get 1.6GB of free ram.
  
  Processing is fast. Installs even large apps in a very short time.
  
  Navigation buttons are backlit.
  
  Charges quickly, in around 2 hrs 45 mins.
  
  Battery is easily lasting for more than a day with moderate to semi-heavy usage. I'm getting 1.5 days
  

  Cons:
  

  One major con is flash doesn't turn on while recording video.
  
  Front flash is weak.
  
  Rear cam is not so good. Dual cam is useless.
  
  Back button is on the left side, so you need to use both hands if you want to go to previous screen.
  
  No music player included. Have to use google play music.
  
  There is only one speaker. Left grill is microphone.

  Provided JBL headphone sound is not good, it has good bass but no treble, 3rd party headphones are giving mind-blowing sound.
  
  If you use headphone (without mic) then the person on other end can't hear you even if you bring the phone close to your face.
  
  Till now nougat update is not available.
  

  That's all pros and cons folks. I got it just for 11,999 on Big 10 sale. So its really a value for money. You can go for it if you can bear with the above mentioned cons and if you are fond of large screen with a good performance.

Got this product few days ago. Packaging was great. Hats off to so fast delivery. Phone box itself is big. When i opened the box, i felt wowww. What a beauty. Large screen, Slim curved body made of metal. Got a 29MB update and done that. Ok, enough intro, lets dig pros and cons
  

  Pros:
  

  Phone itself is a beauty. I feel crazy about large screens.
  
  Size really feels big in hand, gets into pant pockets, no issue with that.
  
  Build quality is very good.
  
  Supports 4g VoLTE. So you can directly call from Jio Sim
  
  A bit bulky but not over bulky. As per size its perfect.
  
  4050 mAh battery.
  
  Has a notification LED.
  
  Music through headphone is very good with dolby atmos.
  
  Loudspeaker sound us loud enough and crispy.
  
  No lag.
  
  Smooth touch.
  
  Gorilla glass protection.
  
  Auto focus is really fast with laser auto focus and PDAF.
  
  Has a front flash.
  
  Front cam is very good.
  
  Minor heating while charging but acceptable, so no heating issue.
  
  Good full hd display which is sharp and vivid, mesmerizing display.
  
  Fingerprint scanner is very fast and accurate.
  
  call quality is good crystal clear voice.
  
  You will get around 23.75 GB user space.
  
  When no app is running you'll get 1.6GB of free ram.
  
  Processing is fast. Installs even large apps in a very short time.
  
  Navigation buttons are backlit.
  
  Charges quickly, in around 2 hrs 45 mins.
  
  Battery is easily lasting for more than a day with moderate to semi-heavy usage. I'm getting 1.5 days
  

  Cons:
  

  One major con is flash doesn't turn on while recording video.
  
  Front flash is weak.
  
  Rear cam is not so good. Dual cam is useless.
  
  Back button is on the left side, so you need to use both hands if you want to go to previous screen.
  
  No music player included. Have to use google play music.
  
  There is only one speaker. Left grill is microphone.
  
  Need to take care while inserting sim. sometime it doesn't want to be inserted. don't force, try delicately.
  
  Provided JBL headphone sound is not good, it has good bass but no treble, 3rd party headphones are giving mind-blowing sound.
  
  If you use headphone (without mic) then the person on other end can't hear you even if you bring the phone close to your face.
  
  Till now nougat update is not available.
  

  That's all pros and cons folks. I got it just for 11,999 on Big 10 sale. So its really a value for money. You can go for it if you can bear with the above mentioned cons and if you are fond of large screen with a good performance.

Must say I was a bit skeptical before buying this phone, mainly because of the reviews mentioning the flaws and stuff, but here is my honest opinion after having used the phone for a while. Also worth mentioning is that I was choosing between three options, Moto G5 Plus, ZTE Nubia Z11 Mini S and the Lenovo Z2 Plus.
  
  DESIGN : Design wise the phone is a no ahit, serious looking business class phone with dual bevelled edges and a proper grip when used with the cover provided in the box. Also, by keeping both the 3.5mm audio jack and the usb port on one side, Lenovo has enabled users like me who use phone in one pocket, and powerbank on the other, to use headphones simultaneously without any issues.
  

  Now coming to the pros and cons
  
  PROS
  
  Overall good aesthetic design
  
  Above par audio when used with good quality headphones
  
  Camera photos in daylight
  
  Extremely smooth performance, no lags EVER.
  
  Battery performance is stellar, gives about a day and half's battery life with mixed usage.
  
  Storage is sufficient for me (I've got the 64 GB Variant).
  
  There are tons of sensors in this thing, including pedometer, and they all work just fine.
  

  CONS
  
  Phone speaker sounds kinda low, and squeaky.
  
  Low light performance is not so great. Just does the job.
  
  There's a VoLTE bug, you'll have to restart after inserting the sim for VoLTE to take effect.
  
  Rear of the phone is an absolute fingerprint magnet. As of now, I don't see many rear screen guards, so best use the film provided, rather than removing it, and then fix the back cover (Jugaad).
  
  Grammatical mistakes and wrong infos are annoying. (The camera settings have options for 1300 and 800 megapixels).
  
  The one button design, though intuitive, takes a while getting used to.
  
  Bluetooth transfer rates are far slower beyond Bluetooth 4.2 standards.
  

  If you want a Snapdragon 820 below 20k, you don't have many options. This one's great for performance, and media consumption. If that rocks your boat, go for it.
  

  Update : Received my Quick Charge 3.0 adapter. Seems it doesn't support that, though it charges just about at the same as QC 2.0, the new nougat update has fixed many things, the only concern now being, well, can't think of anything...

Hi Folks! I'm using for more than a week. Here i am listing down the pros and cons about this device after using more than a week.
  

  Pros:
  
  Looks is very neat and sober.
  
  Build quality is good, though full plastic build but wont feel cheap like i felt with K3 note.
  
  Back is not glossy, doesnt catch fingerprint.
  
  Weight is nicely distributed, doesn't feel overweighted. Pretty light.
  
  Display quality is good, sharp enough and vivid colors.
  
  Call quality is good, no call drop or muddy calls.
  
  Supports VoLTE, using with my Jio sim, working flawlessly.
  
  Camera quality is very good, with a dual led single tone flash, front cam is also good.
  
  Audio through speakers is so loud and clear, it has dual speakers, really good.
  
  Audio through headphones is excellent, supplied earphone is not good but with a good quality headphone its really excellent.
  
  Comes with Waves Maxxaudio technology, can modify equalizer, effects and headphone bass treble mids according to your choice, really outstanding sound.
  
  Has a dedicated micro SD slot.
  
  Though 2nd sim is labelled as 2G on the back however Both SIM supports 4G, but only one at a time, it can be done from internal settings, no need to swap SIM, both slot accepts micro SIM.
  
  Battery backup is very good, easily lasts more than a day with moderate usage.
  
  Didn't notice any over heating, slightly warms up while charging an talking but that's quite normal for all handsets.
  
  Has smart download feature, which means you can download large files using mobile data as well as Wi-Fi at the same time.
  
  Available user memory is around 10 GB.
  
  You'll get nearly 900MB free RAM while no App is running.
  
  Lenovo launcher and Google now launcher both are pre-installed. Google now launcher gives a feel of stock android.
  
  Touch is smooth and didn't notice any lag while using.
  
  Network reception quality is good.
  

  Cons:
  
  RAM management could have been better
  
  Flash could be dual tone
  
  Could have given a front flash
  
  There is no notification light.
  
  Navigation buttons are not backlit, you have to be used-to to work in the dark.
  
  Some bloatware are pre-installed
  

  Overall if we see then this is a very good device at this price of around Rs. 8000. I searched a lot but didn't find a phone with 5.5 inch HD display, 2GB RAM and 16GB onboard storage, specially from a reliable & reputed brand within this price bracket. Hey folks if you too are looking for a phone with such facilities and for this price then you can consider this device. Its a very good phone overall. If you can bear with the above mentioned cons then i'll say you can go for it.

column7:
I'm just one of those fools who doesn't have knowledge about electronic items and just tried to be oversmart by purchasing this after going through its features online.
  
  1. I guess the primary feature of a phone is to 'talk', but this mobile gets angry when you talk for more than 5 minutes, and it shows its anger by getting HOT. Your ear will be in pain, its that HOT. I strongly recommend all the couples who talks a lot on phone, that kindly DO NOT buy this phone, else you will start getting irritated and annoyed and your partner on other side will think twice before calling you because he/she will have to struggle a bit to listen what exactly you are saying. It is more like a skype calling where the other party repeatedly says....'u there...can u listen me, sorry i cant hear u, can u plz repeat..etc. etc. Hence, if anyone wants to break the relationship of a couple can gift this mobile to them. I bet you will get the good news in a week or 2.
  
  Well, the manufacturer had excluded their liability from the same by giving a warning in their booklet that states- "to prevent possible hearing damage, do not listen at high volume levels for long periods"..... Can somebody plz tell me for how long periods?? Its only 6 weeks now since I'am usng this mobile, and I hardly talk for more than 10-15 mints that too in an interval of few days. Apart from this, one will have to listen at full volume so as to hear the other party clearly else..consider yourself deaf.
  
  2 - Now coming to the secondary feature of a phone, which I guess as per Smartphone its a primary feature to use internet. I only use 'whats app', and sometimes 'messenger and fb'. But yet this mobile hang. And most importantly, thanks to the customer care of Flipkart. I asked them to replace this mobile but they suggested me to do some changes in the troubleshooting and asked me to keep doing so after every few days so as to avoid such issues. Wow!!! Don't I have any other work to do. But this doesn't ends here, they also asked me to switch off my internet when its not in use. Great!! So, for others who use internet on mobile for more than wats app purpose, please think over it before purchasing.
  
  3 - Only after a month you will see the sound quality of the music is comparatively not as good as it used to be initially. I can't define technically, but one can make the difference if love to hear songs. Well, once again I cannot blame the manufacturer of Lenovo for this issue because there is a clause in their booklet that states that avoid listening at full volume for prolonged periods of time in order to keep the mobile in good condition.
  
  4 - Don't get panic if your earphone is lost because you can purchase the same quality of earphone from the street at Rs.25/- only.
  
  5 - If you have the habit to see the features of a pic very closely then this mobile is not a good option as you cannot zoom.   Now talking about the phone, i will not be restating the already well known specifications, but the highs and lows of the phone, that i have observed after 20 days of use of phone.
  

  It supports fast charging and charges @ 1% per minute till 70% and then gradually the charge rate slows down to about 1% per 2 mins, In all it approximatly takes 2hrs to fully charge the phone. In a single day use with about 3 hrs of calling and 20 min of gaming with dual sims active with 1 on 3g the battery works for about 24-25hrs. which is ok .!! not great since i have used the lenovo p780 which gave me a backup of almost 2.5 days, but its ok as X2 houses only 2300 mAh battery + 2300mAh addon battery which is being shipped free with the phone, so with the 2300 mAh in built battery and the additional 2300mAh addon battery pack u can easily use the phone for about 2 days!! Which is gr8!
  

  The build quality is exceptionally good, and is very premium it actually makes heads turn.
  

  It has a very good front camera with beautifier mode, (it actually processes the image to make your skin look very smooth and a little fairer which works very well), and rear camera is also very good. but u need to hold the camera quite steady.
  

  it comes in with Lenovo anti-virus, optimizer and anti-theft software. And has some very unique features like
  
  1.	Lift to ear to receive call   it automatically receives the call when u lift the ringing phone to your ear.
  
  2.Ultimate power saver mode that when activated makes the screen go black and white with only call, message and alarm functionality. It drastically reduces power consumption by upto 90% and the phone can service days without charging on this mode. Its like converting the phone into a nokia 1100!! But that comes in very handy when u actually need to save power.

column6: Brilliant device, Held back by battery life
column7:
I bought this phone after much deliberation, lots of intensive research went into my choice. I received this phone on 9th December, and am writing this review after two weeks of usage:
  

  The design:
  
  This is probably one of the reasons I bought this phone. It's simply beautiful to look at, an eye catcher anywhere you take it. The layered design is brilliant, and it feels very sturdy yet not that heavy.
  

  The Performance:
  
  It is very fast, multitasking is smooth though laggy at times if too many apps are running. Games run perfectly, no stutter seen on even high end games like Asphalt 8:Airborne. AnTuTu benchmarked at 44638 with an "Amazing" ranking.
  

  The Display:
  
  The display is gorgeous, with gorilla glass for protection. The touch response is good and the colour reproduction is great. The phone even has contrast modes for long term viewing. Videos look amazing in HD.
  

  The UI:
  
  This is something that a lot of people would not like if they are fans of the stock UI. But for this there are two solutions: either you can open the developer menu and chose stock UI, or you can go for any launcher like I did.
  

  The battery life:
  
  Here is where the vibe x2 fails badly. If you expect a phone which will still have juice after 8 hours, this phone is not for you. However, at the time of my purchase I got the battery Xtension for free, which can double your juice. I recommend buying when the battery pack comes free with the phone. Again, this adds to the weight of your phone so only use it when you require it. Also, there are a wide range of affordable power banks, so I don't think this should affect you too badly.
  

  The camera:
  
  The camera is pretty decent, though it does not match up to other devices in a similar price range. The low light imaging is subpar, but well lit scenery is captured quite nicely. I have yet to try the video recording so I won't comment on that.
  

  The freebies:
  
  The phone by default comes with a transparent crystal case and a screen protection film. The crystal case adds on to the looks but doesn't really do anything in terms of protection; it is weak and will break at the slightest pressure. The screen film will attract a lot of fingerprints. I have not used the earphones that came with the device.
  

  To sum it up;
  

  Pros:
  
  1. Design is amazing
  
  2. Performance is smooth
  
  3. Lightweight
  
  4. Amazing specs at a low price (in my opinion)
  
  5. Great display with vivid colour reproduction.
  

  Cons:
  
  1. Battery Life - Hardly lasts 6 hours on normal usage
  
  2. No USB OTG Support
  
  3. Camera is subpar
  

  Taking into consideration the Camera quality, battery backup and Lack of OTG support, I rate this product 4 out of 5 stars. All things considered, a wonderful product by LENOVO. Definite recommendation to buy.
  

  P.S. Lenovo has made an official statement that they will provide Android 5.0 Lollipop Upgrade in the coming months.

Lacks a menu button (like iphone), all apps are displayed on the home screen itself. U can organize them in folders or add extra screens. It is simpler but if you prefer the menu button and app display like other phones u will need to install some other launcher (available free on play store).
  
  The display is very good with good viewing angles and sharp colors, sunlight visibility is good too. Comes with 32gb internal memory (26gb user available) and 2gb of RAM. The phone runs fast with hardly any lag on browsing or using different apps. Gaming is good too, handles most games smoothly. I did not found any heating issues on moderate usage as mentioned by some other reviewers.
  

  Camera- The front 5mp camera is nice, clicks more than average looking sharp images with good colors and contrast. The back 13mp camera is OK. The outdoor pictures r very sharp and detailed but indoor performance is average. I also felt that the shutter speed is a bit slow so that the image can get blurred if your hands are not very stable. (No optical image stabilization probably). May be this gets fixed with firmware update or by using some other camera app (haven't tried yet).
  

  Battery- Powered by a 2300 mah primary battery and an optional 2300mah battery layer. The battery lasted about 12-15 hrs on moderate usage. However you will need the extra battery layer if u use a lot of internet or play games a lot.
  

  Ear phones & Speakers- The in-ear ear phones bundled with the package r ordinary. The music quality on them isn't good. Good for talking though. You will need to buy some good third party earphones if u listen to music a lot. The phone speaker is loud enough and sound remains clear even at full volume. But I felt that the loudness over ear phones is low especially in noisy surroundings.
  

  Main Disadvantages-
  
  1. Battery life not so good. Extra battery layer adds to weight and thickness (But doesn't spoil the looks much).
  
  2. Back Camera average, good for outdoors though. Needs very stable hands or the image gets blurred. (Front camera is very good).
  
  3. Poor ear phones.
  

  Main Advantages-
  
  1. Very good looking, thin, adequately sized and light weight.
  
  2. Great display and speakers.
  
  3. 32gb internal memory, 2gb RAM and true Octacore processor.
  
  4. Great performance and price.
  

  Overall a good phone to buy at this price. However if size is not a problem and you can handle larger phones consider 1+1. Can also consider Mi 4 (not available currently) and Moto G 2nd ed.

  Mobile Networks\Preferred Network Type\
  
  and then you would find your network operator, mine is Airtel and then if you select that icon you would find options like WCDMA / GSM /...etc.,.. All we need to do is select "GSM only".

I've been using this phone for a few days now and I am overall happy with the value for money. I got it for almost 16K (17999 with 10% off Axis bank) and it includes the snap-on battery backup layer (work 2000).
  


  Overall I am extremely happy about:
  
  1. The looks ! This baby is all-metal sleek and sexy eye turner.
  
  2. Great screen size, brightness and clarity. It is much better than my motog
  
  3. Storage - comes with 32 GB inbuilt memory
  
  4. Has an accelerometer / gyroscope -- very useful if you are a google cardboard fan
  
  5. Lenovo has included almost all useful apps...Kingsoft office, recorder, ShareIT, couple of good games, Compass, Offline Maps (Route 66), Security / antivirus, etc
  
  6. Wifi, BT and GPS are very fast to catch. 2g/3g reception is very good.
  
  7. Packaging and quality of provided accessories is excellent (in-canal earphones, free transparent back cover, charger and cable)
  
  8. Good features like double tap to wake, themes, etc
  
  9. Excellent sound and music clarity, good speakerphone
  


  The below are average scoring areas for this phone:
  
  1. Battery - lasts just a bit more than 24 hrs on a full charge. But that's ok as there was a snap-on battery included in my box.
  
  2. Vibe UI - it's good, no lags or glitches so far. I have replaced the Lenovo launcher with Google Now. Games run very smoothly (NFS, Asphalt, etc)
  
  3. Phone does not heat up as much .... very bearable and expected
  


  Absolutely unhappy about:
  
  1. Lack of USB OTG -- in today's age, how come this is not supported? Especially since there is no SD card slot... I hope Lenovo provides a system update to add this functionality soon.
  
  2. Lack of NFC. For a mid-to-high end phone, NFC should be there.....
  
  3. No clear road-map to Lollipup upgrade.
  


  Bottom-line : Excellent value for money if OTG is supported along with near future upgrade o lollipop.

column6: Flashy phone with patheic battery back up and over hyped features
column7:
I bought this phone last month after reading a few reviews and flipkart's comparison chart. My reviews after 1 month of use:
  
  1) Pathetic battery backup- better to stick to your older phone instead of buying this phone. You need to carry your charger with you. Even without wifi and data services, the phone hardly last for 4-5 hours.
  
  2) Most features of the phone are flashy and do not work as mentioned. There is a Ultimate power saver mode, which is supposed to extend battery standby time. But surprisingly, even in this mode the battery drains @ speed like in normal mode.
  
  3) Automatic timed switch on Ultimate power saver mode does not works.(another not working feature)
  
  4) Gestures features on front camera are unpredictable. You can shout at the top of your voice, but the voice feature may not work for taking selfies.
  
  5) Smart Standby, the screen will light up when u look at it, another non working feature.
  
  6) Smart answer,automatically answers incoming calls when device is is raised next to the ear, another flashy non working feature.
  
  7) Primary camera takes a long time to focus and most pics turn out to be blurred .
  
  8) FLIPKART will make even possible excuse not to take return/refund for this phone. Any request for return will be IGNORED. Need to test flipkart customer care, buy this phone.
  
  9) Flipkart should be doing a proper testing of products going for exclusive sale on its site. Poor products are put for sale after being shown excellent on comparison chart.
  
  10) It takes 2.5 hours to charge the battery but only 5 hours for completely discharge (This phone loves power sockets).
  

  With this kind of battery back up, the battery extension should be made an integral part of this phone, if Flipkart needs to sell it.
  

  Final advice, there are better phone available in this price range, think before buying Vibe X2 or wait for sometime and you could be getting it on Olx at a better price.

Hi.
  

  I bought this phone some time back. The phone was pretty good. Except that
  
  a) It is bulky
  
  b) It is slippery due to metal back.
  

  Now this is a dangerous combination for a phone, as it will keep slipping out of your hand.
  

  I think the designers knew this, so they put in the corning gorilla glass 3 (Phone has corning gorilla glass 3 as per gsmarena), and they provide a plastic back case with the phone.
  

  I dropped this phone around 20~30 time, before a fate full day, when it hit the ground on it's edge. The glass shattered.
  
  As per the official service centre the glass repair is not a part of the warranty, and costs Rs 7000.
  

  I had it repaired via a local electrician, for Rs 2600, with the warranty officially void.
  

  And a few weeks later I dropped it again (even after being very very careful). This time the screen survived. But the motherboard did not (as per the service centre). The phone shut down, when ever i powered it, it would start, flash that it is powering down because the battery is at 0% and then shutdown within 3 seconds.

  Personally I am not buying any Lenovo devices ever again.

column3: Lenovo K3 Note Music Edition (Yellow, 16 GB)
column7:
First of all there is no difference with K3 except for an extra back cover provided with a small speaker.
  
  Its really embarrassing that a music edition phone that costs around 13000RS comes WITHOUT a HEADPHONE.
  
  Regarding the phone :-
  
  - The charging time is very long , takes min 3 hours to get fully charged
  
  - The basic use of proximity sensor is lacking , the phone doesn't lights up automatically when we ope the flip cover.
  
  - The 3 keys in the bottom is NOT LED back lit. Its really difficult to use in landscape mode. Becomes much harder in night.
  
  - The notification pane icons can't be customized.
  
  - The default applications cant be uninstalled. Even if its disabled it will ask you to update. This will surely irritate you.
  
  - The cam quality is not upto the level . Especially in low light conditions. Also there is no image size settings
  
  - The side keys are not smooth. you will find it a bit uneasy to lock and unlock.
  
  - The phone doesnt give the full power of a octa core processor and 2 gb ram . Its lagging some times . especially when you open recent apps.

Every boy has some dreams that they know will never come true.Like dating deepika, driving a hot red ferrari or owning a flagship phone of a reputed company under 15k. But thanks to flipkart one of them has come true!!
  
  In a time where phones can be mistaken for TV, the compact form is a breath of fresh air. Fits snugly in one hand and in pocket. The black model is really elegant in a quiet manner.The matte back cover provided actually enhances the beauty of the phone
  
  Not much to say about performance....snapdragon 820+adreno 530 really breezes through everything 130000 antutu score testify to that
  
  The home button is truly unique with multi gesture support, takes a little time to master it but after that you wont want to use anything else
  
  Battery is adequate for 1 day of heavy usage....may drain a little quickly when the phone is new
  
  Call quality is crystal clear..data speed is excellent. Even my old 3g sim is giving 500kbps speeds....just think what this beast will do with 4g
  
  But everything in life has some cons, so does this phone
  
  Camera while good in day light , really struggles in low light no OIS, laser autofocus
  
  No fast charger in box though it supports fast charging
  
  Phone gets a bit hot while doing extensive heavy gaming
  
  All in all after exchange price of 14k, there is hardly any better phone for people who likes compact sizes.And with nougat update in the horizon, reasons for not opting for this monster are really very few.

Must say I was a bit skeptical before buying this phone, mainly because of the reviews mentioning the flaws and stuff, but here is my honest opinion after having used the phone for a while. Also worth mentioning is that I was choosing between three options, Moto G5 Plus, ZTE Nubia Z11 Mini S and the Lenovo Z2 Plus.
  
  DESIGN : Design wise the phone is a no ahit, serious looking business class phone with dual bevelled edges and a proper grip when used with the cover provided in the box. Also, by keeping both the 3.5mm audio jack and the usb port on one side, Lenovo has enabled users like me who use phone in one pocket, and powerbank on the other, to use headphones simultaneously without any issues.
  

  Now coming to the pros and cons
  
  PROS
  
  Overall good aesthetic design
  
  Above par audio when used with good quality headphones
  
  Camera photos in daylight
  
  Extremely smooth performance, no lags EVER.
  
  Battery performance is stellar, gives about a day and half's battery life with mixed usage.
  
  Storage is sufficient for me (I've got the 64 GB Variant).
  
  There are tons of sensors in this thing, including pedometer, and they all work just fine.
  

  CONS
  
  Phone speaker sounds kinda low, and squeaky.
  
  Low light performance is not so great. Just does the job.
  
  There's a VoLTE bug, you'll have to restart after inserting the sim for VoLTE to take effect.
  
  Rear of the phone is an absolute fingerprint magnet. As of now, I don't see many rear screen guards, so best use the film provided, rather than removing it, and then fix the back cover (Jugaad).
  
  Grammatical mistakes and wrong infos are annoying. (The camera settings have options for 1300 and 800 megapixels).
  
  The one button design, though intuitive, takes a while getting used to.
  
  Bluetooth transfer rates are far slower beyond Bluetooth 4.2 standards.
  

  If you want a Snapdragon 820 below 20k, you don't have many options. This one's great for performance, and media consumption. If that rocks your boat, go for it.
  

  Update : Received my Quick Charge 3.0 adapter. Seems it doesn't support that, though it charges just about at the same as QC 2.0, the new nougat update has fixed many things, the only concern now being, well, can't think of anything...

Hi Folks! I'm using for more than a week. Here i am listing down the pros and cons about this device after using more than a week.
  

  Pros:
  
  Looks is very neat and sober.
  
  Build quality is good, though full plastic build but wont feel cheap like i felt with K3 note.
  
  Back is not glossy, doesnt catch fingerprint.
  
  Weight is nicely distributed, doesn't feel overweighted. Pretty light.
  
  Display quality is good, sharp enough and vivid colors.
  
  Call quality is good, no call drop or muddy calls.
  
  Supports VoLTE, using with my Jio sim, working flawlessly.
  
  Camera quality is very good, with a dual led single tone flash, front cam is also good.
  
  Audio through speakers is so loud and clear, it has dual speakers, really good.
  
  Audio through headphones is excellent, supplied earphone is not good but with a good quality headphone its really excellent.
  
  Comes with Waves Maxxaudio technology, can modify equalizer, effects and headphone bass treble mids according to your choice, really outstanding sound.
  
  Has a dedicated micro SD slot.
  
  Though 2nd sim is labelled as 2G on the back however Both SIM supports 4G, but only one at a time, it can be done from internal settings, no need to swap SIM, both slot accepts micro SIM.
  
  Battery backup is very good, easily lasts more than a day with moderate usage.
  
  Didn't notice any over heating, slightly warms up while charging an talking but that's quite normal for all handsets.
  
  Has smart download feature, which means you can download large files using mobile data as well as Wi-Fi at the same time.
  
  Available user memory is around 10 GB.
  
  You'll get nearly 900MB free RAM while no App is running.
  
  Lenovo launcher and Google now launcher both are pre-installed. Google now launcher gives a feel of stock android.
  
  Touch is smooth and didn't notice any lag while using.
  
  Network reception quality is good.
  

  Cons:
  
  RAM management could have been better
  
  Flash could be dual tone
  
  Could have given a front flash
  
  There is no notification light.
  
  Navigation buttons are not backlit, you have to be used-to to work in the dark.
  
  Some bloatware are pre-installed
  

  Overall if we see then this is a very good device at this price of around Rs. 8000. I searched a lot but didn't find a phone with 5.5 inch HD display, 2GB RAM and 16GB onboard storage, specially from a reliable & reputed brand within this price bracket. Hey folks if you too are looking for a phone with such facilities and for this price then you can consider this device. Its a very good phone overall. If you can bear with the above mentioned cons then i'll say you can go for it.

Been using it for more than a week now, will get straight to the review (please keep in mind, after reading every point, that this phone costs 11K :D )...
  

  Screen: 960x540 px @ 4.7in, so not the finest one out there. But pretty bright... perfefctly usable under sunlight. Touch sensitivity is average. Viewing angles are OK.
  

  OS: Came with JB 4.2.2, got an OTA upgrade to KK 4.4.2 last week! Smooth and fluidic animations, no lag.
  

  Sound: Loudspeaker volume is more than average, tends to reproduce the higher frequencies a bit too much but the sound is crisp and pleasant. The sound cracks a bit on absolutely full volume, but if you set it a notch below full volume it should be fine. Sound from the earpiece is clear.
  

  Performance: MTK 1.3GHz QC + 1GB - Scored an impressive 18300 something points on AnTuTu benchmark test! And I quote from its results page: "CPU: Good - supports large apps and multitasking, RAM: Excellent, 2D & 3D graphics: Good - Fluently support most games".
  

  Battery life (my main reason for getting this phone): Amazing! Mostly because Lenovo did their math right... To make the most of your device and put the 'mobility' aspect back in this mobile, they packed in a 3000mAh battery to power the above hardware. The result - more than 1 full day of agressive use / 2 days of moderate use - on single charge. My usage is a little less than average, and I usually get 2 full days + 25% juice left (WiFi on half of the time, 3-4 hrs of Email/Internet/Whatsapp/FB, around 2 hours of calling and at least an hour of fiddling around with different apps)
  

  Camera: Rear 8MP snapper is decent, colours are natural, but images are a bit soft (this is due to agressive compression, but on the upside the image size is kept low... < 1MB). Front VGA camera is disappointing, but I guess if I had to make a video call in a well-lit environment, it would suffice.
  

  Miscellaneous: Network reception is good, tactile feedback of buttons is good, looks and feels very premium because of the aluminium back cover (tends to slip out of the hand easily for the same reason), the "magic case" seems to be a good accessory at first, but I noticed that the flexible strap was starting to leave a mark on the back cover of the mobile, like somebody else said in an earlier review. So I stopped having it on all the time (and suggest you do the same). All of the available internal memory is useable for installing apps, which should be more than enough!
  

  Overall: A really nice product for the price... Go for it!

  4.Connectivity(3.5/5): It is dual SIM.First slot supports upto 4G and Second slot upto 2G.

  6.UI(4/5): It has Android Kitkat 4.4.4 running with Vibe UI, which is smooth and user friendly.And with this RAM and Processor, it works really well. Lenovo has promised to release lollipop Update for it. Lenovo has released some updates, but i suggest to take some time before downloading any updates, because some updates may disappoint you.
  

  7.Battery(3/5):It has 2300 mAh replacable battery, which once charged upto 100%, gives me a backup for whole day, with average use like surfing, playing games, watching videos.I turn on data, only when i need it, so it may vary from person to person.In idle condition, battery drop is 1-2% in 2hrs, which is good.
  

  8.Sound(3/5): Though Lenovo is giving 'Dolbi Digital' technology for sound, but i didn' feel
  
  anything extraordinary about it.Two speakers at back side do their work well and are loud and clear enough to hear in a crowded and noisy environment.They have not provided Earphone with this, so i purchased Senheiser's earphone that works well with this.Watched movies and found the quality decent, not as good as my last Sony Xperia GO
  

  CONS:
  
  With so many good features and hardware it has only one major Con that troubled me a lot and that is HEATING.When i searched, i found that almost every person having it, suffering from same problem.
  
  I also complained flipkart about this issue and asked for replacement, but their answer was "It is normal for this phone to heat upto 48degrees and unless it is upto that temperature, we will not replace it."In user manual, came with phone, it is mentioned that don't operate it above 42degree, So their excuse is totally unacceptable.
  
  So I searched more and found that when I unmount my 16GB class 10 memory card, the heating issue is gone and this is the reason, i gave 2 out of 5 for Storage, When u can't use expandable memory what is the use of it.Looks like, I am using a Pen drive.The reason for this is, their ROM is not able to manage 'Mediaserver' app effectively,
  
  when i checked, i found it was consuming 80% of battery, which is not more than 5& in other phones.One solution i found for this issue, is putting a .nomedia file on your memory card and then use it.In this case some apps will not show content of memory
  
  card, but this is how u have to use it.
  

  So overall a good phone for 7.5k, with only one major drawback, HEATING.May be in future updates, they will resolve this issue and the phone will be perfect.

column6: Lenovo A6000 Plus - heating and batter issue resolved
column7:
Hello All,
  

  I have bought Lenovo A6000 plus from Flipkart some 15 days back. Returned the product within 5 days due to batter issue and very high level of heating of the phone.
  

  I got replacement of the phone - still same issue. So the culprit was not the battery and I started looking  for solution.
  

  The issue was with the SD Card (I used 32GB SD Card as is form my older android phone running on v4.2) To try
  
  1. I backed the data on SD card, erased the data completely while the card was in new phone (Lenovo A6000 plus).
  
  2. un-mount the SD card.
  
  3. Shutdown the phone.
  
  4. Remove the SD Card from it's slot.
  
  5. Start phone without SD Card.
  
  6. Keep phone running for around 2-3 minutes.
  
  7. Shutdown the phone.
  
  8. Insert the SD card which was erased and un-mounted into SD card slot and start the phone.
  
  9. Start using the phone for around 10-15 mins.
  
  10. Now do one last shutdown and start of the phone.
  

  This procedure has helped me resolve the high batter consumption issue as well as excessive heating issue of the phone.
  

  Hope this will help others to get similar issues resolved.
  
  After this the phone runs very smoothly and of course as suggested by others here try to disable/uninstall unnecessary softwares that comes pre-loaded. this will help in making phone even better in terms of responsiveness and increased internal storage will be added benefit.
  

  Thanks,
  
  Swapnil

I got the phone a couple of days back and let me highlight my usage facts.
  

  Performance - Noticed stuttering/lagging every couple of seconds even on less intensive games such as Angry Birds, Subway Surfers and Temple Run. However the lag is less pronounced on heavy games such as Dead Trigger 2 and Riptide GP2 and hardly noticeable. The lag is quite annoying such that playing the above basic games is an eyesore.
  

  Display - The display is an IPS HD display (1280 x 720 - very common in these range phones) which is sharp and the brightness good enough (not too high).
  
  Sound - The twin speakers are quite loud enough and the sound is crisp. The Dolby effect is good for the price. No complaints here.
  
  Browsing - Browsing experience was smooth with the inbuilt chrome browser.
  
  GPS - Got an accurate lock on my location even when inside my home away from the windows. No complaints here as well.
  
  Camera - Average 8 MP camera which is good enough for the casual shooters but not pros. Details are not well highlighted and pictures seem to be quite saturated. Front camera is good but not great.
  
  Storage - This is one place where Lenovo beats similar priced phones. You get about 11.5 GB out of 16 gigs.
  
  RAM - This is another area where Lenovo outsmarts similar price tags. As stated, the RAM is 2 GB and you get about 1.3 - 1.4GB free RAM.
  
  Heating - I didn't notice much heating as many have posted. Probably, the firmware I am using (Kraft-A6000-s_S010_150515) is throttling the CPU or battery heat as was the case in prev Redmi 1s firmware. Maybe the lags in UI and games could be because of this.
  
  Battery - I noticed that the battery life is not bad. It lasted an average of a day's charge on normal usage with some casual gaming. May be this has to also do with some CPU throttling as stated above.
  
  Overall, based on my usage, if you are casual user with frequent videos/music playback and calling/ internet browsing this is a great phone for the price.
  

  If you are more into gaming, please avoid this phone.

column6: Excellent Budget Phone Within this Price Range, Highly Recommended.
column7:
First of all to all those spammers & fake reviewers writing about Heating issues, There is little heating which is definitely under control & it can never be considered as a drawback.
  
  I am writing this review after 1 Week of High Usage.Ordered this Product on 10th June & Received on 12th Early morning, so Flipkart delivery good as always ! Before talking about anything else, Let me tell you what kind of user I am becoz in the end you will prefer the phone which match your requirements not what any xyz reviewer says. Thats the approach to be followed always.
  
  So I am not a heavy gamer 1st of all. I do play games but not always. I listen to music, watch videos & the Most part of my mobile usage is Calling, SMS, Net Surfing, Chatting etc.
  
  Now come to the review things, I will rate most of the important aspects within 5.
  
  1) CAMERA (Primary 8 MP , Secondary 2 MP) :- In Camera section I would say it gives you a decent experience, pictures come out to be nice. However i would consider the Primary Camera as not good as expected. Though the size of images which it captures is above 2 MB, but whenever We try to zoom it on a Computer Screen the pixels get blurred after applying 3XZoom. However the color reproduction is nice & pictures are detailed. All this is about Daytime Images, while in Night it does decent job but in indoor condition with low lighting if we flash for clicking a pic at larger distance the Pics are VERY POOR
  
  Talking about Selfi Cam, some times it Feels It gives better experience than the primary one. The Secondary camera is a 2 MP shooter which does a nice job.
  
  Overall for Camera Section I will give : 3/5 for Primary & 4/5 for Secondary Cam.
  
  2) BATTERY : For many people, battery is very major aspect of mobile usage. The battery in device does an awesome Job. Talking about my experience when I am fully connected to internet using net based apps, a full 100% charge battery gave me a backup of 16+ Hrs. I WAS CONNECTED TO WIFI FOR THE WHOLE 16 HRS CONTINUOUSLY. Also I played games, listened to music, done calling.
  
  If we do normal calling say (10-12 Calls a day) + Music/ Videos (1 Hr) + Net Surfing/Chatting (2-3 Hrs) + Gaming (15 Min to 30 Min), then the battery is expected to give 15-17 Hrs of Backup.
  
  The Standby Time is surely above 20+ hrs, which include only Calling of few calls a day. Would give 4.5/5 for the Battery
  
  3) Sound Quality, Voice Call Quality, Ringtone Volumes : The Call quality for Voice calls are good. Also the speakers gave a very nice experience while playing games or listing music on speakers & making loud speaker calls. Also the Ringtone Volume is decent, not much Loud but its OK.
  
  4/5 for this Section.
  
  4) Gaming : Though I am not gamer but still for testing I tried Asphalt 8, Mordern Combat 5, Real Cricket, Death Shooter 2, Hill Climbing, Temple Run, Subway Surf. I have to say all the games were running very smoothly on this device. Somewhere the 2GB RAM has huge impact in good gaming exp on this Phone. However Playing games produced a little heat up near the camera (little not too heavy) & also battery drainage is high when we play heavy games.
  
  Will give 3.5/5 for this Section.
  
  5) Processing, Touch & Internet Apps Usage : It comes with Chrome & UCB pre-installed. The internet surfing on this device is excellent. Pinch to Zoom feature works absolutely fine and websites load quite fast. Also the chatting using skype, messanger,whatsapp run very smooth. The touch is indeed very responsive & all apps run smooth. Even tried whatsapp,skype & messanger Voice Calls, all ran perfect on this Device.
  
  Will give 4/5 in this section.
  
  6) Looks,Design,Build Quality : This looks a pretty premium phone with very minimum rounded edges. The build quality is great and it supports 5 point multi touch. The only drawback in this section is the absence of Backlid menu buttons & LED Notification light.
  
  Will give 3.5/5 in this Section.
  
  7) Headphones,OTG,Charger : The phone doesnt comes with a headfone, but on listing sounds in headphones the phone does a quite remarkable Job. Also the Phone at present doesnt support OTG but I dont think I am going to use any OTG Pendrive in near future so it doesnt bother me. I got a white color USB Charger which seems to be OK type.
  

  Will give 3.5/5 in this section.
  
  Thats all from my side. I have been using this phone & I am very much satisfied with its performance apart from primary camera (not bad but not very good too). My Overall rating would be 4/5 for this Phone.
  
  PS : The phone got very very heated on 1st Boot but since 2nd Boot there never came any such issue :)
  
  Remember while buying phone take helps of reviews for getting to know about features & cons. However buy phone as per your requirement only as If I like Chocolate Icecream doesnt mean you will do the same.
